name: mailadmin/mailadmin
description: Web administration interface for a Postfix / Cyrus IMAP / MySQL mail server.

scripts.analyse:domain: sh -c 'if [ -n "$(find src/Domain -name \*.php -print -quit)" ]; then vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --configuration=phpstan-domain.neon.dist --no-progress; else echo "src/Domain holds no PHP files yet (F4 fills it) - skipping the level max pass."; fi'

scripts-descriptions.test: Runs the PHPUnit suites (unit, application, contract, integration).
scripts-descriptions.lint: Checks the coding style without changing files.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Runs PHPStan (level 8 overall, level max for src/Domain).
scripts-descriptions.build: Produces every build artefact under var/cache. Extended by later packages.
scripts-descriptions.build:openapi: Merges openapi/**.yaml into var/cache/openapi.bundled.{yaml,json} and checks it against OpenAPI 3.0.
scripts-descriptions.build:routes: Compiles the route table from the bundled contract; fails on a missing handler or a missing x-permission.
scripts-descriptions.migrate: Applies pending migrations under the database lock. The deployment runs this; composer install deliberately does not.
scripts-descriptions.migrate:status: Prints the schema state and changes nothing.
scripts-descriptions.migrate:check: Lists what would run and verifies the additive-only rule. Exits 1 when something is pending.
scripts-descriptions.db:check: Reports charset, collation and storage engine of the legacy tables, plus the migration state.
scripts-descriptions.check:deployment: Probes a deployed installation for paths that must not be readable (U-25). Takes the base URL.
